title: ScriptoriumTrace
description: One scriptorium skill invocation on one manuscript artifact, with the user actions that followed. The canonical record format for telemetry and eval data. Closes #47.

trace_schema_version.description: Schema version. Bumped when fields are added, removed, or semantically changed so older records remain identifiable.

submission_id.description: Stable identifier for this record. Enables right-to-delete from any aggregated dataset.

scriptorium_version.description: Version of the scriptorium package that emitted (or extracted) this record.

consent_tier.description: Which data tier the user opted into for this record. structured-only: counts and metadata only, no text content. output-text: + skill output text. manuscript-chunk: + the manuscript chunk the skill ran on. Tier enforcement is encoded in the conditional schema below.

provenance.description: Where this record came from. Enables aggregation discipline across capture surfaces.

session_id.description: Surface-specific session identifier. For claude-code-transcript, this is the Claude Code session UUID.

transcript_path.description: Local path the record was extracted from, if applicable. Not transmitted under any sharing tier.

name.description: Skill name without the scriptorium: prefix, e.g. citation-audit, reviewer-simulation, argumentative-flow.

version.description: Skill version if available from the skill manifest.

invocation_surface.description: The surface the skill was invoked through.

thinking_used.description: Whether the model used extended thinking during this skill invocation.

thinking_text_captured.description: Whether the thinking text itself is recorded in this trace. Claude Code transcripts persist thinking-block structure but NOT thinking text, so this is false for source=claude-code-transcript records even when thinking_used=true.

manuscript.description: Non-content metadata about the manuscript the skill ran on. Available in all tiers. The manuscript text itself only appears in tier 3 (manuscript-chunk).

discipline.description: Free-text discipline tag, e.g. biomedical, ml-systems, condensed-matter-physics.

section.description: Section the skill ran on, e.g. introduction, methods, results, discussion, full.

language.description: Author language self-report. Optional; unspecified is the default.

skill_output.description: What the skill produced. Counts and structural fields available in all tiers; the freeform output text is tier 2 (output-text) or higher only.

suggestion_counts.description: Counts of suggestions by category, e.g. {strong: 3, moderate: 5, weak: 2}.

finding_counts.description: Counts of findings by category, e.g. {citation-overreach: 2, missing-citation: 1}.

text.description: Full skill output text. Tier 2 (output-text) or tier 3 only. Forbidden at tier 1.

manuscript_chunk.description: The manuscript chunk the skill ran on. Tier 3 (manuscript-chunk) only. Forbidden at tier 1 and tier 2.

user_actions.description: What the user did with the skill output, when capturable. Optional; may be empty if the capture surface cannot observe user actions.

free_text_feedback.description: User-supplied free-text feedback on the skill output. Only collected when the user explicitly types it; never inferred.
